title: Completion of Review by Community Advisory Panel for Quantitative Noise Threshold for Neighbourhoods
what_it_is: Completion of Review by Community Advisory Panel for Quantitative Noise Threshold for Neighbourhoods

sections.label: Quiet hours and noise threshold review
sections.summary: Consultations on extending quiet hours, a Community Dispute Management Framework, and a residential noise threshold review are expected to conclude before end-2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: At present, we are focusing on consulting relevant community stakeholders on the feasibility of extending the quiet hours as recommended by the Panel.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We are also working with the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth and the Ministry of Law to strengthen the inter-agency Community Dispute Management Framework, which includes preparations for the pilot unit of dedicated personnel to address serious cases of neighbour noise disputes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The review on whether to establish a residential noise threshold has begun.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We plan to work with academia on a technical study and draw on references from thresholds practiced in other jurisdictions before commencing wider consultations with relevant agencies and experts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We expect to be able to conclude the review before end-2024.

sections.label: Dedicated personnel pilot unit
sections.summary: The pilot unit of dedicated personnel aims to test processes and resourcing, with the intention to eventually roll it out nationwide.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: As for the unit of dedicated personnel, we will share more information of the duration of the pilot.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: The intention is to eventually roll this out to the whole nation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: The purpose of the pilot is more to determine whether the processes are working as intended and also, whether the resourcing is right.
